clues: This city sits in the East Bay, by the great bay in northern California. It is the East Bay city that lies closest to Silicon Valley.
This place gets little rain, because high hills to the west steal the wet air first. Summers are warm and dry, and winters are cool and wet.
This city was made in 1956, when five old towns joined into one. It was a new city built from parts that were much older.
The biggest job site in this city is a huge Tesla plant. Thousands of workers build cars there each day.
The oldest mark of this place is its Spanish mission from 1797. A Spanish priest set it up, and a town grew up around it.
